# About this script

Computes every value reported in the manuscript's tables, so each table
can be checked against the data. Run the three data structuring scripts
first. Each table's section prints a formatted table (as reported) and
the unrounded values behind it.

# Packages and data

```{r}
library(dplyr)

samples <- list(
  "MIDUS 2" = readRDS("../midus_2/M2_analysis_data_fulltime_standard.rds"),
  "MIDUS Refresher 1" = readRDS("../midus_refresher/MR_analysis_data_fulltime_standard.rds"),
  "MIDUS 3" = readRDS("../midus_3/M3_analysis_data_fulltime_standard.rds")
)

# Drop diary days with no recorded weekday (weekend missing), as the
# modeling scripts do (2 MIDUS 3 days; none in MIDUS 2 or the Refresher)
samples <- lapply(samples, filter, !is.na(weekend))
sapply(samples, nrow)

# Formatting helpers
f2 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ",")
n_pct <- function(n, pct) {
  paste0(format(n, big.mark = ","), " (", formatC(pct, format = "f", digits = 1), ")")
}
m_sd <- function(m, s) paste0(f2(m), " (", f2(s), ")")
```

# Table X: Descriptive statistics for the analytic samples

Full-time, standard-shift samples. Percentages of no-TV days use days
with a TV report; percentages of weekend days use all diary days.
Between-person SD is the SD of person means; within-person SD is the SD
of each day's deviation from the person's own mean.

```{r}
# Overall M, SD, median, and between- and within-person SD of a
# diary-day variable (days with the variable reported)
describe_levels <- function(data, variable) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na({{ variable }})) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(
      person_mean = mean({{ variable }}),
      deviation = {{ variable }} - person_mean
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean = mean({{ variable }}),
      sd = sd({{ variable }}),
      median = median({{ variable }}),
      between_sd = sd(person_mean[!duplicated(id)]),
      within_sd = sd(deviation)
    )
}

describe_sample <- function(data) {
  person <- data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(
      age = first(age),
      sex = first(sex),
      days_worked = first(days_worked),
      total_work_hours = first(total_work_hours),
      any_tv = any(tv_duration_minutes > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  pairs <- data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(sleep_next_night_minutes) & !is.na(tv_duration_minutes))
    )

  sleep <- describe_levels(data, sleep_next_night_minutes)
  tv <- describe_levels(data, tv_duration_minutes)

  tibble(
    participants = nrow(person),
    age_mean = mean(person$age),
    age_sd = sd(person$age),
    n_women = sum(person$sex == 1), # sex: 0 = male, 1 = female
    pct_women = mean(person$sex == 1) * 100,
    days_worked_mean = mean(person$days_worked),
    days_worked_sd = sd(person$days_worked),
    work_hours_mean = mean(person$total_work_hours),
    work_hours_sd = sd(person$total_work_hours),
    n_any_tv = sum(person$any_tv),
    pct_any_tv = mean(person$any_tv) * 100,
    sleep_mean = sleep$mean,
    sleep_sd = sleep$sd,
    sleep_between_sd = sleep$between_sd,
    sleep_within_sd = sleep$within_sd,
    tv_mean = tv$mean,
    tv_sd = tv$sd,
    tv_median = tv$median,
    tv_between_sd = tv$between_sd,
    tv_within_sd = tv$within_sd,
    n_no_tv_days = sum(data$tv_duration_minutes == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_no_tv_days = mean(data$tv_duration_minutes == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    n_weekend = sum(data$weekend == 1),
    pct_weekend = mean(data$weekend == 1) * 100,
    diary_days = nrow(data),
    n_missing_sleep = sum(is.na(data$sleep_next_night_minutes)),
    pct_missing_sleep = mean(is.na(data$sleep_next_night_minutes)) * 100,
    n_missing_tv = sum(is.na(data$tv_duration_minutes)),
    pct_missing_tv = mean(is.na(data$tv_duration_minutes)) * 100,
    pairs_sleep = sleep$n,
    pairs_sleep_tv = sum(pairs$n),
    pairs_per_person_mean = mean(pairs$n),
    pairs_per_person_median = median(pairs$n)
  )
}

table_x_values <- bind_rows(lapply(samples, describe_sample), .id = "sample")

# Unrounded values
table_x_values %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-sample) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
# As reported
table_x <- with(table_x_values, tibble(
  sample = sample,
  "Participants, N" = format(participants, big.mark = ","),
  "Age, M (SD)" = m_sd(age_mean, age_sd),
  "Women, n (%)" = n_pct(n_women, pct_women),
  "Days worked, M (SD)" = m_sd(days_worked_mean, days_worked_sd),
  "Hours worked, M (SD)" = m_sd(work_hours_mean, work_hours_sd),
  "Watched TV on >= 1 diary day, n (%)" = n_pct(n_any_tv, pct_any_tv),
  "Next-night sleep (min), M (SD)" = m_sd(sleep_mean, sleep_sd),
  "Between-person SD / within-person SD (sleep)" =
    paste(f2(sleep_between_sd), "/", f2(sleep_within_sd)),
  "Daily TV (min), M (SD)" = m_sd(tv_mean, tv_sd),
  "Mdn (TV)" = format(tv_median),
  "Between-person SD / within-person SD (TV)" =
    paste(f2(tv_between_sd), "/", f2(tv_within_sd)),
  "Days with no TV, n (%)" = n_pct(n_no_tv_days, pct_no_tv_days),
  "Weekend days, n (%)" = n_pct(n_weekend, pct_weekend),
  "Diary days, N" = format(diary_days, big.mark = ","),
  "Days missing sleep, n (%)" = n_pct(n_missing_sleep, pct_missing_sleep),
  "Days missing TV, n (%)" = n_pct(n_missing_tv, pct_missing_tv),
  "Day-pairs with sleep (Models 1a-2a)" = format(pairs_sleep, big.mark = ","),
  "Day-pairs with sleep and TV (Model 2b)" = format(pairs_sleep_tv, big.mark = ","),
  "Complete pairs per participant, M (Mdn)" =
    paste0(f2(pairs_per_person_mean), " (", pairs_per_person_median, ")")
))

table_x %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "Statistic") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# Model 3 panel sample (reported in text)

Participants in the full-time, standard-shift samples at both MIDUS 2
and MIDUS 3. Days are those with a next-night sleep report (the rows
used by Models 3a and 3b).

```{r}
panel_ids <- intersect(samples[["MIDUS 2"]]$id, samples[["MIDUS 3"]]$id)

panel <- bind_rows(samples[c("MIDUS 2", "MIDUS 3")], .id = "wave") %>%
  filter(id %in% panel_ids)

panel_values <- panel %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  summarise(
    participants = n_distinct(id),
    age_mean = mean(age[!duplicated(id)]),
    age_sd = sd(age[!duplicated(id)]),
    n_women = sum(sex[!duplicated(id)] == 1),
    pct_women = mean(sex[!duplicated(id)] == 1) * 100,
    days_with_sleep = sum(!is.na(sleep_next_night_minutes))
  )

as.data.frame(panel_values)

# Total days used by Models 3a and 3b
sum(panel_values$days_with_sleep)
```
